newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $2.268 bln for wk of Nov 11.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $2.268 bln for wk of Nov 11.

text.p: Scheduled competitive and negotiated municipal bond sales are expected to total $2.268 billion in 105 offerings for the week of Nov 11, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Competitive sales total $808 million in 66 offerings. The largest competitive issue is a $184 million Virginia Transportation Board on Thursday.
Negotiated sales total $1.46 billion in 39 offerings. The largest issue is a $180 million Chicago Toll Bridge deal through PaineWebber Inc.
One negotiated deal totaling $24.6 million is on Reuter's day-to-day calendar for Thursday, November 7, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issue depending on market conditions.
